records.rationale: Removes stale CMDLINE_EXTEND/debug compression/thermal-trip config entries only in Microdroid. No SDK configuration change is required; the historical claim of unchanged Microdroid .config was not independently built here. Affirmative target evidence: ACK BUILD.bazel assigns these files to distinct kernel_*_microdroid, kernel_*_crashdump or kernel_*_allmodconfig targets. The authorized build_virt.sh selects kernel_x86_64_dist and virtual_device_x86_64_dist, whose definitions use GKI/sdk and virtual-device fragments. No general source or Kconfig definition changes in this candidate. The alternate target is outside the current delivery, not proven to have no Android consumer.

ack_target_blocks:
name = "kernel_x86_64_microdroid",
    srcs = [":kernel_x86_64_sources"],
    outs = X86_64_OUTS,
    arch = "x86_64",
    defconfig = "arch/x86/configs/microdroid_defconfig",
    make_goals = [
        "bzImage",
    ],
    makefile = ":Makefile",

name = "kernel_x86_64_crashdump",
    srcs = [":kernel_x86_64_sources"],
    outs = X86_64_OUTS,
    arch = "x86_64",
    defconfig = "arch/x86/configs/crashdump_defconfig",
    make_goals = [
        "bzImage",
    ],
    makefile = ":Makefile",

name = "kernel_x86_64_allmodconfig",
    srcs = [":kernel_x86_64_sources"],
    # Hack to actually check the build.
    # Otherwise, Bazel thinks that there are no output files, and skip building.
    outs = [".config"],
    arch = "x86_64",
    defconfig = "//build/kernel/kleaf:allmodconfig",
    make_goals = [
        "bzImage",
        "modules",
    ],
    makefile = ":Makefile",
    post_defconfig_fragments = ["arch/x86/configs/allmodconfig.fragment"],
    visibility = ["//visibility:private"],

validation: All changed CONFIG lines and path sets examined, selected and alternate build target definitions read, common effective config values confirmed. Alternate guest/allmodconfig kernels not built or executed. No source edits.
